summary: Winn Parish tower named on a 1949 USGS map and in a 1957 newspaper item; no source read says whether it still stands.

notes_for_editor: The Pastmaps description of Winona sits under the 1949 Jonesboro map card on the Dodson page; the card title is quoted here and the map sheet itself was not opened, so the 1949 date rests on Pastmaps. The 1957 item is quoted by the Forest Lookouts page from The Monroe News-Star; the newspaper was not read directly, and the item does not say what the tower was used for. The record has no agency, and no build date, height, status, access, or staffing appears in any source read. The Forest Lookouts state list also shows Winona in Winn Parish. No NHLR or FFLOS listing for Winona in the cached registers. A Facebook post found in search mentions Winn Parish fire towers in general; it was not used. Statewide fire-tower context (1915 funding; 1950 count of 56) is from Wikipedia, whose history section cites sources this run could not confirm; it describes the state network, not this tower.
